pr_title: do not return err when PodSandbox not exist
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?** 
/kind bug

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

with --cpu-manager-policy=static, kubelet will panic when pause container lose during kubelet restarting

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #98218
same as #98225 (rebased)

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:

```release-note
kubelet: fix panic when pause container loses during kubelet restarting
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:

AFAICT this was merged into the 1.24 release branch:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/release-1.24/pkg/kubelet/cm/container_manager_linux.go

However "108325" is not in the v1.24 release notes:

So it's hard to tell what k8s version actually has this fix.
@pacoxu Can we consider  merge this pr to 1.23 release branch?

```

```

**EDITED:** We met the same problem with no setting `--cpu-manager-policy=static`. So I edited the release note here.
We are facing this issue in "1.21.12" , is there a plan to backport this fix to 1.21 or 1.22 ?

issue_context.title: kubelet will panic when pause container lose during kubelet restarting
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:
with --cpu-manager-policy=static
kubelet will panic when pause container lose during kubelet restarting

**What you expected to happen**:
kubelet can start normally

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:
1,config kubelet with --cpu-manager-policy=static
2, Run a large number of pods on the test node
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: test
  labels:
    app: test
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: test
  replicas: 25
  strategy:
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 50%
      maxUnavailable: 0
    type: RollingUpdate
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: test
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: test1
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command: ["sleep", "1000000"]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 5m
            memory: 10Mi
        ports:
        - containerPort: 81
          name: test
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /data
          name: test-conf-file
          subPathExpr: test
      - name: test2
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command: ["sleep", "1000000"]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 5m
            memory: 10Mi
        readinessProbe:
          exec:
            command:
            - cat
            - /dev/null
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
        ports:
        - containerPort: 82
          name: test
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /data
          name: test-conf-file
          subPathExpr: test
      volumes:
      - name: test-conf-file
        hostPath:
          path: /data
          type: Directory
```


3,stop kubelet use command: `systemctl  stop kubelet`
4,kill and remove all the pause container like this:
```
for line in `docker ps | grep test | grep "pause" | awk '{print $1}'` ; do  echo $line; docker kill $line; docker rm $line; done
```
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1468240/105174877-24f4ab80-5b5e-11eb-8872-ef930ced8e06.png)

5,start kubelet use command: `systemctl start kubelet`

and then kubelet maybe panic, log is :
